clarity_communication.justification: Voice consistent: Roo and Cal anchor every minds-on. Vocabulary named explicitly. Success criteria use 'I can' phrasing.

alignment.justification: Curriculum codes (E2.1-E2.3) mapped lesson-by-lesson. Summative rubric covers all 3 with descriptors matching blueprint text. Image-text alignment passes.
